flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (DN2/DR3 reminder query, exclusion list, DataHive contact refresh, combineNotices, batch SMS), framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (stage DN2 -> DR3), framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload,download} (particulars check), utilities/suspension_helpers/SuspensionBaseHelper, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService. ocmsadminapi operational/cronproxy/CronProxyService (manual trigger). ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no driver reminder code
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so 'Sesuai' means the code follows the story text. This story joins two things: opt-out / electronic reminder (same as OCMS12.43) and the Epic OCMS8 particulars check for notices whose next stage is DR3. The MHA check for NRIC exists and is active in PROD (upload 09:00/14:00/21:00, download 11:30/16:30/23:30), but the order is by date: the code does not wait for the reminder to be sent or the opt-out to be checked. Gaps: (1) the electronic reminder does not run on its own (cron.notification.enabled=false, sms.enable=false with no allowedSources in PROD); (2) OCMS-DF-2026-183 (Pending Closure) reports MHA enquiry files piling up in PROD and results not written, OCMS-DF-2026-176 (Ready to UAT) about timestamps; (3) the DataHive FIN/UEN job is off in PROD and passport has no path; (4) loadAllExcludedIds is fail-open. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-183, -176, -177, -134, -130, -180.
recommendation: Claim partially (70%). The NRIC check with MHA and opt-out handling exist, but the electronic reminder does not run on its own, an open MHA defect in PROD remains (OCMS-DF-2026-183), the FIN path is off, and passport has no path. Ask for evidence that MHA results are saved in PRD once OCMS-DF-2026-183 is closed, and URA confirmation of the FIN/passport scope.

steps.step: A driver who opted out of electronic reminders (exclusion list) is recognised and skipped, the notice stays on the letter track
steps.detail: The reminder query drops IDs found in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134) and the job checks again against the preloaded list before the SMS batch is prepared: IDs on the exclusion list are skipped and for reminders the stage is not changed, the notice stays on the letter track (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-232); passport holders cannot be eNotified and are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:237-243). The content of the exclusion list is DB data: cannot verify from repo. One thing to watch: loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the read fails (fail-open, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1212-1214), so on a read error the opt-out is not enforced at the job gate. Same fit as the exclusion step in OCMS12.8.

steps.step: A driver who did not opt out receives the electronic reminder that refers to the 2nd letter
steps.detail: DN2 reminder sending uses the same SMS batch as OCMS12.43 (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-291). The reminder query does not take notices that already have an SMS/email record for the same stage and service type within a set day window (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1135-1150), so there are no duplicate sends. Partial because cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236; NotificationJobsScheduler.java:48-52) and sms.enable=false with no sms.allowedSources in PROD (application-prod.properties:87; SmsUtil.java:401-409); the full scope is in OCMS12.43. The order 'reminder first, then check' is not enforced by the code: the next check runs by date (next_processing_date) and does not wait for the reminder to be sent.

steps.step: A driver notice whose next stage is DR3 is selected for the particulars check with MHA (Epic OCMS8)
steps.detail: MhaNricDataHelper selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= tomorrow and suspension_type NULL or TS-HST/UNC (MhaNricDataHelper.java:186-199, 208-216), then only owner_driver rows with offender_indicator = 'Y' and id_type 'N' (MhaNricDataHelper.java:345-346). A driver notice whose next stage is DR3 (set after the DN2 letter, see OCMS12.41) is included one day before the DR3 letter date. The upload job is enabled in PROD, Monday-Saturday at 09:00, 14:00 and 21:00 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106). Same as the NRIC selection step in OCMS8.3. The check runs by date; the code does not wait for the electronic reminder to be sent or the opt-out to be checked.

steps.step: The driver's latest particulars (name, address) are received from MHA and saved
steps.detail: Upload: MhaNricUploadJob reads the data, builds the request file name and puts the file in blob to be encrypted and sent to the MHA SFTP (MhaNricUploadJob.java:156, 197, 217). Download: the name is written to the offender row (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:854) and the mha_reg address only for the notice named in the file and rows that are still the offender (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:765-784); a new address only becomes letter_address when no address flagged Y exists yet (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:2321-2322). TS-NRO for an invalid address is refused when the last stage is RR3/DR3 (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:70, 185-190), while this notice is still at last stage DN2. Both jobs are enabled in PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106, 119-120). Partial because of OCMS-DF-2026-183 (Pending Closure): enquiry files pile up in /mhanro/input and MHA rejects the batch, and results are not written in PROD; OCMS-DF-2026-176 (Ready to UAT) about upd_date timestamps; OCMS-DF-2026-130, -134, -177 (Closed) fixed the address overwrite and offender check. COMCRYPT encryption and the MHA SFTP: cannot verify from repo. Same fit as OCMS8.3.

steps.step: Drivers holding a FIN or passport are also checked before the 3rd letter
steps.detail: The MHA path is only for id_type N (MhaNricDataHelper.java:346). FIN-holding drivers are taken by the DataHive UEN and FIN job, which selects notices with next stage RD1-DR3 and id_type F or B (DataHiveUenFinService.java:221-243), but that job is off in PROD (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:52). Foreign passport holders (id_type P) are not selected by any query (DataHiveUenFinService.java:239; MhaNricDataHelper.java:346): no code. So only some ID types are covered and the FIN path is off. Same as OCMS8.3 and OCMS8.4.
